system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: any mountains. Root of stone forces its way through mountain cracks, growing almost entirely beneath the rock and exposing only a tuft of stiff grey leaves. The root becomes encrusted with the minerals around it until it resembles a natural vein of ore. After long boiling it softens enough to be chewed into a gravel-like pulp that fills the body with ponderous strength. Reduce your Weakened condition by 1. You cannot benefit from Root of Stone again until you complete a Full Rest. On the sheet: You cannot benefit from Root of Stone again until you complete a Full Rest. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
